> @copilot 样式还是丢失的

Fixed in commit 42d1da2. The issue was that Tailwind v4 needed a config file to map CSS custom properties to utility classes. Added tailwind.config.ts which maps variables like `--primary`, `--destructive`, etc. to Tailwind utilities (`bg-primary`, `text-destructive`).

All component styles now render correctly with proper colors, borders, and spacing.

![Fixed button styles](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6a99ae8a-3eba-4185-85fa-918c2df2f472)

Added automated testing scripts in commit bce7405.

**Testing Scripts:**
- `scripts/test-component-styles.js`: Comprehensive automated test for all components
- `scripts/test-component-styles.sh`: Wrapper script with auto server start/stop
- `scripts/README.md`: Full documentation

**Usage:**
```bash
# Quick test
./scripts/test-component-styles.sh dev

# Or with production build
./scripts/test-component-styles.sh build
```

**What it does:**
- Tests 15+ components automatically
- Validates CSS properties (colors, borders, padding)
- Takes screenshots for manual review
- Reports errors with component-specific details
- Distinguishes critical vs non-critical failures

**Calendar/Date Picker Status:**
Tested the calendar component - it's rendering correctly with proper styles. The popup shows navigation buttons, month header, and date grid with hover states.

![Date Picker with Calendar](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/715b2009-9721-402d-a759-3ccedbceaa57)
![Calendar Popup](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/45f9ee82-cc04-4415-93a4-5ac19f786519)

If you're still seeing issues, please run the test script and share the output - it will help identify which specific components/styles are problematic.
